# justools.in

> justools.in builds small web tools that turn AI instructions and project plans into diagrams people can question and fix. AI suggests changes; the human decides.

## Tools

- [Skill Flow Mapper](https://justools.in/skill-flow-mapper): Upload a SKILL.md, Markdown playbook or zipped skill folder. See its workflow as a diagram or mind map, review AI suggestions for gaps, and export PNG, SVG, Mermaid or Markdown. Works with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini using your own API key.
- [Project Flow Mapper](https://justools.in/project-flow-mapper): Turn a project plan or workflow into a diagram, review AI suggestions and export the result. [CONFIRM description]
